newsitem.title: USA: Ascent says Q1 loss due to On Command.
newsitem.headline: Ascent says Q1 loss due to On Command.

text.p: Ascent Entertainment Group Inc said Monday its first quarter net loss widened due to operating losses incurred at its subsidiary, On Command Corp, lower revenues from the NBA Denver Nuggets and higher costs for the NHL Colorado Avalanche.

On Command, a provider of video, entertainment and information services for the hotel industry, acquired a majority interest in SpectraVision Inc and suffered satellite failure at some of its hotel rooms.
SpectraVision, another hotel services company, filed Chapter 11, the company said.

Ascent said a new arena in Colorado, which is seen as a key to its sports franchises' financial success, remains one of its top priorities. Until those issues are resolved, Ascent does not expect significant improvements in the performance of those businesses, it said.
Ascent's net loss for the first quarter 1997 was $17.7 million, or $0.59 per share, compared to a loss of $11.8 million, or $0.14 per share, for the same period last year.
